items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: Baby Dodds and Johnny Dodds, they raised in Wayland, Mississippi. They used to walk from Wayland to Basin, Lewis, to go to school. We went to school together.

ctx.x: Tell me, how did Baby play in the old days? Oh, he was good. Was he always good? I know he's good now. Of course, he has a stroke now. But I mean, I never heard him in the old days. All right.
Baby Dodds and Johnny Dodds, they raised in Wayland, Mississippi. They used to walk from Wayland to Basin, Lewis, to go to school. We went to school together. Oh, I didn't know.
